name: Deputy Lindqvist
blurb: A soft-spoken county deputy who never raises his voice and never stops writing.

look.description: A county deputy in a green rain jacket with the hood out, a white helmet and a flashlight on her belt.

meta.notes: The region's local cop (region-pnw, playtest 1c), with Sgt. Pruitt's starting numbers. Sample line (agent draft): "I'm not upset. I'm just writing it all down." He carries the taser (the cops polish round, 2026-10-01: each region's cop is armed, per M4 cops-3; the quiet weapon for the quiet deputy), so you can snatch it off him mid-swing. [default]
